results.title: Expected after India’s Ladakh naming, the FM’s trade-barrier callouts & tighter FDI PN3 scrutiny for China.
results.description:
Expected after India’s Ladakh naming, the FM’s trade-barrier callouts & tighter FDI PN3 scrutiny for China.

Chinese are posturing. Beijing rarely imposes permanent bans; expect waivers. Licensing bottlenecks create uncertain lead times for Indian EPC contractors pricing Chinese equip—next 'case-by-case' waivers may force contractors to disclose precise project locations & site data to MOFCOM to prove "non-military" use.

Bottomline: suit up & invest—or suck up and stop the border posturing without sufficient leverage.

results.title: China's curbs on TBMs, walking excavators, plateau shotcrete machines and dredger components tighten supply for India's metros, rail and bor
results.description: China's curbs on TBMs, walking excavators, plateau shotcrete machines and dredger components tighten supply for India's metros, rail and border tunnels. Domestic firms positioned to gain from localisation push and reduced Chinese imports include BEML (developing indigenous TBMs and partnering on dredger spares) and L&T (equipment manufacturing and major infra projects). Cochin Shipyard and Dredging Corp of India also advance local dredger capacity.
